requirements.source_finding: Standalone web/core and Python loopback launcher are in Draft source; independent distribution/native install/target repository acceptance not proved.
requirements.missing_evidence: Independent release, native packages, true repository handoff/rollback.

requirements.source_finding: Checksum-validated GNSS NMEA, satellite orbital references and experimental 2D ranges/TDOA constraints exist. TDOA explicitly returns positionFix:false, not an MLAT fix.
requirements.missing_evidence: GNSS-SDR correlation/PVT, calibrated synchronized receiver timing, genuine aircraft multilateration.

requirements.source_finding: Unvalidated RMS residual and factor-three heuristic RF ranges exist; bounds explicitly are NOT statistical confidence. No PSF/Gaussian or covariance solver evidenced in inspected positioning modules.
requirements.missing_evidence: PSF/Gaussian estimator with synthetic error tests, uncertainty calibration and observed validation.

requirements.source_finding: Rings use 96 sampled segments (API 24..720); receiver in-memory history caps at 500 and survey source entries at 60. No audited spatial index, incremental fitter or large-ring benchmark.
requirements.missing_evidence: Large dataset/time-budget performance tests, spatial index and incremental fit tests.

requirements.source_finding: Imported measured, demo, RF model and browser-accuracy circles are visually distinguished; aircraft references are separate. No independent aircraft COVERAGE rings vs Location/LIVE Fit/BEST Fit ring families evidenced.
requirements.missing_evidence: Distinct source/LIVE/BEST/Location ring controls and visual regression suite.

requirements.source_finding: RF-only mode excludes OS/GNSS/cached sources and capture is opt-in; Hard Stop is connected to app-owned release. However setRfOnly(false) calls compute() and does not call USB release, so RF Off lifecycle guarantee is unverified.
requirements.missing_evidence: RF OFF disabled computation/lease release + background/stale capture integration test.

requirements.source_finding: Nine named method layers, local preferences, browser drag/markers, PWA offline grid and saved references are coded. OSM tiles remain online-dependent; complete offline basemap and EN/TR/DE localization acceptance not evidenced.
requirements.missing_evidence: Native/offline mobile basemap and gestures, persisted coordinate selector, GUI translations.

requirements.source_finding: 3+ externally calibrated fixed GROUND stations permit an unverified RF-only RSSI hypothesis without OS lat/lon; 3+ aircraft are categorically excluded from the ground-station solver, and decoded ADS-B positions are reference-only.
requirements.missing_evidence: Actual independent aircraft-derived measurements with valid timing/geometry, 3+ aircraft regional estimate and anti-false-fix gates.

blockers: P0: GNSS-SDR PVT and independently timestamped/synchronized aircraft multilateration missing.
P0: RF-only OFF not demonstrated to stop compute() or release USB receiver, despite Hard Stop path.
P1: PSF/Gaussian calibrated uncertainty and separate Location/LIVE/BEST fit ring families not evidenced.
P1: High-density spatial indexing/incremental fit and real performance budgets not evidenced.
P1: EN/TR/DE UI locale parity, offline maps, native cross-platform acceptance and rollback not verified.
Cross-team: Flight Radar actual antenna ADS-B/provenance integration is a dependency; see Issue #77.
methodology: Read-only GitHub connector file inspection and PR comparison; fixture/pure-code/static-regex tests inspected, not run; no physical receiver or installed software touched.
evidence_limitations: No hardware tests, no local test runner, no CI job started or green check asserted.
Core evidence is pinned to audit source SHA and file blob SHA.
Requested feature acceptance is not implied by source path/test presence.
Original Draft PR #16 and audit branch are divergent; ten sampled file blob identities match but complete branch parity has not been certified.

phase4.scientific_contract: ADS-B decoded aircraft coordinates identify aircraft, not receiver; single SDR lacks synchronized independent station receiver clock/TX times. RSSI and horizon circles are heuristic. Never claim GPS, calibrated MLAT, TDOA self-location, measured accuracy or 1-sigma confidence.
phase4.preservation_caveat: Do not merge PR #16 or Flight #13/#14, cherry-pick into main, or interpret cross-repo interfaces as integration acceptance.
